definition: BCCFAt A a t says t is true at a and every contingent truth at a is a conjunct of t. No arena is assumed to contain such a t. CommonReason says one fact is a reason for every contingent truth member by member, which is not a reason for a reified whole.
note: Analyst-stated condition for the comparison arena of #755; it is under test, not asserted. A sourced reading would need a pinned witness from the #409 or #365 intake.
